system.description: If you concentrate, you can create small illusions in your environment, such as a false object in hand or a person walking down a nearby hallway. They cannot be touched, heard, or perceived in any way other than sight, and close inspection will reveal obvious flaws. The further away you are, the less detailed a form you can create- forming an effect beyond a distance of one hundred feet produces little more than a blurry outline. When you test the limit of your abilities with this feature, the Judge may call for an INTELLECT | MAGIC check.
